liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Welcome**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **Lonesome Whistle**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **All Of Tomorrow**: back after 69 archived shows (672 days) [6]
- **I Washed My Hands In Muddy Water**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **Look Up Look Down That Lonesome Road**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 9 archived performances [6]
- **Jam**: back after 66 archived shows (663 days) [6]
- **Working’ On A Building**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [6]
- **Elderly Woman Behind The Counter In A Small Town**: rare: 11 archived performances [6]
- Earliest performances in the archive: *I’ll Be Gone A Long Time [6]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2021-12-09.bstrings** (recommended): source not stated; 24 songs; 131 min [1]
- **billystrings2021-12-09**: source not stated; 24 songs; 132 min [2]
- **billystrings2021-12-09.tfunk.tk60.mitchell.flac2448**: source not stated; 22 songs; 132 min [3]
- **billystrings2021-12-09.mk41**: source not stated; 22 songs; 131 min [4]

## Around the show

- Lineup listed: William Apostle on acoustic guitar, Royal Masat on bass, Jarrod Walker on mandolin, Billy Falling on banjo, all singing [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2021-12-09.bstrings**: taped by David Dyche; transferred by David Dyche; source: Neumann 150’s > (Clamped To The Rail Of The Mezzanine) V-3 > Sound Devices 744 24/96 [1]
- **billystrings2021-12-09**: taped by Z-Man; transferred by Z-Man; source: Schoeps CCM4V'S>Lunatec V2>Sound Devices 722 (24/44.1) [2]. Also: Z-Man recorded and seeded it: Schoeps CCM4V mics, Lunatec V2 preamp, Sound Devices 722 at 24-bit/44.1, clamped to the mezzanine rail; Processed from the 722 through Sound Forge 10 and CD Wave to 16-bit FLAC, tagged in Foobar 2000; Dirty South Recording [2]
- **billystrings2021-12-09.tfunk.tk60.mitchell.flac2448**: taped by Jeff Mitchell; transferred by Jeff Mitchell; source: Telefunken TK60 > Telefunken M60 > Zoom F8n > SDXC > Samplitude Pro X5 > dBpoweramp > Foobar Live Show Tagger > Traders Little Helper [3]. Also: Jeff Mitchell recorded and processed it with Telefunken TK60 capsules on M60 mics into a Zoom F8n, 24-bit/48k [3]
- **billystrings2021-12-09.mk41**: taped by davidpuddy; source: Schoeps mk41 > nbob actives > baby nbox > Mixpre-6 ii [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by @BillybaseDotNet: [Billy Strings The Eastern - Atlanta, GA - BillyBase](https://billybase.net/show/the-eastern-atlanta-ga/) [7]
